description: Test suite for authorization and permission checks in Mattermost server channels, including session permissions, role-based permissions, team and channel access, and post read permissions.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionTo
methods.description: Tests various session permission checks including basic user, admin, and unrestricted sessions.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToAndNotRestrictedAdmin
methods.description: Tests permission checks with restricted and unrestricted admin settings.

methods.name: TestCheckIfRolesGrantPermission
methods.description: Verifies role-based permission grants for different roles and permissions.

methods.name: TestChannelRolesGrantPermission
methods.description: Tests permission inheritance for channel roles.

methods.name: TestHasPermissionToTeam
methods.description: Checks if users have permissions to access teams.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToTeams
methods.description: Verifies team access permissions for different user roles and team memberships.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToChannel
methods.description: Tests channel access permissions for users, including archived and private channels.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToChannels
methods.description: Checks multiple channels access permissions, including error handling when fetching channels fails.

methods.name: TestHasPermissionToUser
methods.description: Verifies user permission checks, including admin and self permissions.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToManageBot
methods.description: Tests bot management permissions for different user roles and permissions.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToUser
methods.description: Checks if sessions have permission to specific users, including admin and user manager roles.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToManageUserOrBot
methods.description: Verifies permissions for managing users and bots, including error cases.

methods.name: TestHasPermissionToCategory
methods.description: Tests category permission checks within team sidebar categories.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToGroup
methods.description: Tests group permission logic based on CSV data, role permissions, and group membership.

methods.name: TestHasPermissionToReadChannel
methods.description: Checks read permissions for channels under various configurations and user roles.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToChannelByPost
methods.description: Verifies channel permissions based on posts and user roles.

methods.name: TestHasPermissionToChannelByPost
methods.description: Tests permission checks for channels via post IDs, including error handling.

methods.name: TestHasPermissionToChannel
methods.description: Checks detailed permission logic for channels, including admin override and archived channels.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToReadChannel
methods.description: Verifies if users can read channels based on membership, permissions, and channel state.

methods.name: TestSessionHasPermissionToReadPost
methods.description: Tests post read permissions for various user roles and post/channel states.
